public.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
public.faq.sub: Everything about requests, quotations, CBE payments, verification and disputes.
public.faq.q1: How do I find a worker?
public.faq.a1: Use the Find Workers page or the home-page search. Filter by service, city, availability, price, rating, emergency service and verified-only status.
public.faq.q2: How do I request a service?
public.faq.a2: Log in as a customer, open My Requests → New Request, choose the category, describe the problem, attach photos, set your location, preferred date, budget and urgency.
public.faq.q3: How does the quotation system work?
public.faq.a3: Matching workers see your request and submit an itemised quotation (labour, materials, transport, total, duration, warranty, payment plan). You compare them and accept one — that creates the booking.
public.faq.a4: Manually through Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE) — via CBE app, CBE Birr, ATM or a branch. The booking page shows the exact account name, number, branch and amount for the due payment phase.
public.faq.q5: Does the website process my money?
public.faq.a5: No. Local Handyman has no payment gateway, does not receive or hold funds, and cannot transfer money. It only displays instructions, records what you report, and stores the proof you upload for manual review.
public.faq.q6: How do I upload payment proof?
public.faq.a6: Open the booking → payment phase → 'Submit payment proof'. Enter amount, CBE transaction reference, sender name, payment date and upload the screenshot. The phase then shows 'pending verification'.
public.faq.a7: An authorized platform verifier opens your proof in the admin Payment Verification Center, compares the reference, amount, date and screenshot, then marks it verified or rejected with a reason.
public.faq.q8: What happens if my payment proof is rejected?
public.faq.a8: You receive a notification with the exact reason (amount incorrect, unclear screenshot, wrong reference, etc.). Correct the submission and upload again — the phase returns to proof submission.
public.faq.q9: What if I underpay or overpay a phase?
public.faq.a9: The system flags both: 'Underpayment — X ETB remains' or 'Submitted amount exceeds the required phase amount'. A verifier reviews these cases manually.
public.faq.a10: Yes, before work starts. Cancellations are recorded on the booking timeline and in your history. Repeated cancellations are flagged for review.
public.faq.q11: What happens when a worker does not arrive?
public.faq.a11: Report a problem on the booking — it becomes disputed and our team reviews messages, photos, payment records and the timeline before making a decision.
public.faq.q12: How do I report a problem?
public.faq.a12: Open the booking and use the dispute/report action, or contact support from the FAQ page. Include the booking code so we can find the full history quickly.
public.faq.q13: How do I become a worker?
public.faq.a13: Register as a worker, fill in your profession, skills, service area and availability, and upload your ID plus skill/training certificates. Our team verifies documents before you can quote on jobs.
public.faq.q14: What does the verified badge mean?
public.faq.a14: The platform reviewed the worker's identity and skill documents and approved them. It is a document check, not a guarantee of workmanship.
public.hiw.title: How Local Handyman works
public.hiw.sub: A complete, transparent flow from posting a job to reviewing a finished one — with payments handled manually through CBE and verified by real people.
public.hiw.step1.title: 1. Register
public.hiw.step1.body: Customers sign up in seconds. Workers create a detailed profile and submit ID/skill documents for verification.
public.hiw.step2.title: 2. Find a worker
public.hiw.step2.body: Search by service, skill, city, availability, price, rating or emergency availability — or browse categories.
public.hiw.step3.title: 3. Create a service request
public.hiw.step3.body: Describe the problem, add photos, choose your location, preferred date, budget and urgency (normal / urgent / emergency).
public.hiw.step4.title: 4. Receive quotations
public.hiw.step4.body: Matching workers send itemised offers: labour, materials, transport, total, duration, warranty and a payment plan.
public.hiw.step5.title: 5. Compare and accept
public.hiw.step5.body: Compare offers side by side. Accepting one instantly creates the booking with work phases and payment phases.
public.hiw.step6.title: 6. Pay through CBE
public.hiw.step6.body: The system shows the CBE account name, number, branch and exact amount for the due phase. You transfer manually using your CBE channel.
public.hiw.step7.title: 7. Upload payment proof
public.hiw.step7.body: Enter the transaction reference, sender name, amount and date, attach the screenshot and submit. The phase becomes 'pending verification'.
public.hiw.step8.title: 8. Manual verification
public.hiw.step8.body: An authorized platform verifier checks your proof against the details and marks it verified — or rejects it with a clear reason so you can resubmit.
public.hiw.step9.title: 9. Work happens in phases
public.hiw.step9.body: The worker checks in, completes each work phase, and uploads before/during/after evidence you can see live.
public.hiw.step10.title: 10. Confirm and review
public.hiw.step10.body: When the worker marks the job complete, you inspect it and confirm. Then you rate quality, communication, punctuality and professionalism.
public.hiw.money1b: never collects, holds or transfers money.
public.hiw.money2: No card gateway, Telebirr, Chapa, Stripe or PayPal integration exists.
public.hiw.money3: You pay the worker's CBE account directly, then submit proof here.
public.hiw.money4: A verifier manually reviews every proof; the platform only keeps records.
public.hiw.money5b: records of manually made CBE payments.
